dlg.wayfinder.first.0.note: Brisk Edinburgh. 'Good.' approving. A lively catalogue of places, relishing each. The last two sentences drier and darker.

dlg.wayfinder.hub.0.note: A beat where the name would be. Approving.

dlg.wayfinder.hub.1.note: A beat where the name would be.

dlg.wayfinder.oaths.0.note: A cartographer's precision. 'Those are the choices.' dry gallows humour.

dlg.wayfinder.places.0.note: Rules laid out briskly. 'I sell them fewer maps.' deadpan.

dlg.wayfinder.drawn.0.note: Plain trade. The dead drawn 'from where their light went out' quieter, almost tender.

dlg.wayfinder.notes.0.note: Vague list, a little too light. Pause. Then lower, almost a warning: 'So has he.'

dlg.wayfinder.cb_opened_vault.0.note: Dry, with real fear under 'that far down'.

dlg.wayfinder.say_calling.2.note: 'I've a margin for people like you.' dry and ominous.

dlg.wayfinder.say_calling.3.note: Pointing at the map. A joke at the reavers.

dlg.wayfinder.say_calling.4.note: Pointing at the map. A joke at the reavers.

dlg.wayfinder.t_wayfinder.0.note: 'Once.' The facts, plain. 'My brother didn't.' steady. 'I still can't get the corners right.' dry, and it hurts.

dlg.wayfinder.margin.0.intent: asks your name for the margin
dlg.wayfinder.margin.0.note: Proud of her tidiness. Narrator: the pen. 'Speaking of which.' The question light.

dlg.wayfinder.margin_name.0.note: Narrator for the writing and blotting. 'There.' A little ceremony in the last line.

dlg.wayfinder.margin_nobody.0.note: 'Nobody.' Narrator: without blinking. A dry joke with a chill.

dlg.wayfinder.margin_lark.0.note: Narrator for the look. 'Lark.' decided. Fond teasing.
